TextView.android:text:
• The API key uses the same device-bound encrypted storage path as BYD Cloud credentials and is never returned.

• Chat history stays only in this session's memory and is cleared when leaving.

• Vehicle context is sent only for an explicit grounded action.

• Starting voice opens a provider-native realtime session through the daemon.

• When the master switch is off, active calls are cancelled and transports are destroyed.

• Requests fail closed if an expected proxy route is unavailable.
